columns.name: Facility ID
columns.description: A unique ID for the facility.

columns.name: Address 1
columns.description: The street address of the facility.

columns.name: Address 2
columns.description: The room number, floor number, or other address information secondary to the street address.

columns.name: Begin Date
columns.description: First date the facility will be offering vaccinations.

columns.name: End Date
columns.description: Last date the facility will be offering vaccinations.

columns.name: Active
columns.description: Is the facility currently offering COVID-19 vaccinations?

columns.name: City Operated
columns.description: Is the facility operated by the City of Chicago?

columns.name: Location
columns.description: The location of the facility in a format that allows for creation of maps and other geographic operations on this data portal.

columns.name: Boundaries - ZIP Codes
columns.description: This column was automatically created in order to record in what polygon from the dataset 'Boundaries - ZIP Codes' (rpca-8um6) the point in column 'location' is located.  This enables the creation of region maps (choropleths) in the visualization canvas and data lens.
